subject: Renewal & capacity uplift — procurement portal re-onboarding and approval plan
messages:
From: Emily Song <procurement@zenara.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Miguel Alvarez <miguel.alvarez@zenara.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: term extension + 30% capacity bump — procurement portal re-onboarding

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for a productive renewal conversation last week. Zenara is ready to move forward with a 24-month term extension and an initial 30% seat/capacity uplift tied to our Q4 launch. Procurement needs us to complete a quick vendor re-onboarding in our portal so the PO can be issued and routed to Finance.

What we need from Redwood to unblock the PO lane:
- Updated SOW reflecting the term change and capacity tiers (we prefer a single SOW with an attachment for tiered pricing).
- SOC 2 evidence or the most recent snapshot (we do a light attest for vendor risk).
- Contact for vendor portal invite (email that will receive the portal link).
- Expected PO routing: Zenara/Finance requires invoice to go to AP@zenara.com and legal copy to be sent to agreements@zenara.com.

We can initiate the portal re-onboard now if you can supply the SOW + SOC2 artifact. Would appreciate a draft SOW by EOD Friday 6/18 so our procurement queue can process before month-end.

Attachments: I’ve attached our internal renewal checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Emily Song
Senior Procurement Manager
Zenara Health
procurement@zenara.com

---
Attachment stub: zenara_renewal_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com

Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: term extension + 30% capacity bump — procurement portal re-onboarding

Hi Emily — thanks for outlining the asks. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Laura (legal) and Monica (account owner) so we can coordinate the SOW and artifacts. High-level plan from our side:

- SOW: Ben/Monica to produce an updated SOW with tiered pricing by EOD Fri 6/18. We will include a section for the 24-month term and clear capacity tranche definitions.
- SOC2: attaching a redacted SOC2 snapshot and an internal attestation note. Laura, please confirm whether the redaction covers the items procurement typically requests.
- Portal invite: Please send the portal invitation to vendor-portal@redwoodinference.com (we monitor that inbox for procurement invites).
- PO routing: we will configure billing details to match AP@zenara.com and provide a billing contact to both your AP and agreements teams.

Next steps: Ben will drop the SOW draft in the shared Drive and post a DocuSign link when legal signs off. We propose a short MAP (mutual action plan) — milestone-level — that I’ll include in the SOW doc so Zenara procurement can align internal approvals.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Lead, Renewals
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com

Subject: RE: Renewal: term extension + 30% capacity bump — procurement portal re-onboarding

Emily / team — attaching SOW v3 (draft) with the capacity ladder and the 24-month term language. Main changes from last version: explicit commit tiers, billing cadence options, and a one-time onboarding credit for the uplift month.

Ask from legal: Laura flagged two small redline items on payment terms and indemnity carveouts — she’ll add inline comments in the Drive doc. Emily, if you can confirm preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly) we’ll finalize pricing lines for the PO.

Proposed MAP (high level):
- 6/18: Redwood provides SOW draft + SOC2 snapshot (done).
- 6/19: Zenara internal procurement to re-onboard vendor in portal; Zenara confirms PO routing and billing cadence.
- 6/21: Legal redline resolution + DocuSign.
- By 6/25: PO issued to Redwood AP.

I’ve posted the SOW to the shared link and kicked off DocuSign once legal signs.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

1) Documents attached/shared:
- Zenara_SOW_v3.pdf (final draft with MAP included)
- SOC2_snapshot_2027-05.png (redacted snapshot)
- DocuSign link for SOW: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-zenara-sow

2) Action items for Zenara procurement: 
- Please send the vendor portal invite to vendor-portal@redwoodinference.com so we can accept and populate your vendor profile.
- Confirm billing cadence (monthly or quarterly) and the AP contact for the PO (we have AP@zenara.com listed).
- Resolve any remaining legal comments by replying to the Drive doc or we can do a 15-minute call to walk through the redlines.

We’re ready to accept the portal invite and sign once you confirm billing cadence. Happy to jump on a short call today if that helps.

Best,
